title: The 5 AM Club Grasps the Essentialness of Sleep
coreMove: Sleep is performance infrastructure: it restores the capacities that Victory Hour depends on for energy, mood, learning, and repair.

exampleSpecs.audience: people adding 5 AM without changing bedtime
exampleSpecs.stakes: early rising can fail because the prior night remains chaotic

exampleSpecs.audience: high performers treating sleep as weakness
exampleSpecs.stakes: quality of judgment declines when rest is treated as leftover time

exampleSpecs.audience: people whose screens delay sleep descent
exampleSpecs.stakes: late stimulation can ruin the morning's emotional state
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use screens and stimulation as threats to morning quality

exampleSpecs.stakes: unresolved agitation can follow the person into dawn
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Include emotional agitation as sleep threat

exampleSpecs.audience: people isolating the wake time from recovery
exampleSpecs.stakes: 5 AM becomes brittle when it is not paired with sleep rhythm
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use rising early and sleeping well as paired behaviors

exampleSpecs.stakes: learning suffers when memory is starved by poor sleep
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Connect sleep with memory and learning
